file:
format: 1
project: proofs
session: proofs-team
visibility: public
coordinator: coordinator-seat
operator: operator-seat
identity:
  humans:
    - Dana Example
rules:
  - sign every commit
trust:
  - ../shared
workspace:
  mode: shared
watch:
  interval: 2m
  checks:
    unsent: off
budgets:
  accounts:
    openai:
      kind: subscription
      reserve: 20%
      sources:
        - status_line
seats:
  - role: coordinator
    name: coordinator-seat
    cli: claude-code
    vendor: anthropic
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    version: "5.5"
    launch: claude
  - role: implementer
    name: operator-seat
    cli: codex
    vendor: openai
    account: openai
    model: gpt-5.3
    version: "5.3"
    launch: codex exec
